<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 17" pfs="Standard">[Aiuen, The Elf-Gate Key](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=41)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=534" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
<trait label="Teleportation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=710" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 61

**Usage** drawn on a creature

</column>

---

This masterful circular rune is a key to the aiudara network of elf gates that stretch across the stars. Once per turn, when the rune-bearer [Strides](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305), it can instead teleport a distance equal to its Speed.

**Invocation**
You teleport the rune-bearer to a location adjacent to any of your other runes, as long as it is on the same plane. An unwilling target can be teleported a maximum distance of 60 feet, and it avoids being teleported at all if it succeeds at a Will save against your class DC.

---
If you have the ability to cast the [_sigil_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1673) cantrip, then you can use _aiuen, the elf-gate key's_ invocation to teleport the rune-bearer to a location adjacent to any of your sigils on the same plane, in addition to any of your runes.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 9" pfs="Standard">[Astillu, Rune of Submersion](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=25)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=732" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 59

**Usage** drawn on a creature

</column>

---

Originating from Thalassic script, this wavy rune is popular with iruxi practitioners of rune magic who want to easily traverse their watery environs. The rune-bearer can breathe underwater and gains a [swim Speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2351)  equal to its land Speed or 30 feet, whichever is greater. Its melee [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) don't take the usual circumstance penalty for passing through water.

**Invocation**
The rune's power pushes the bearer forward in a surprising surge of speed. The rune-bearer can [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) up to 60 feet as a free action, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=604" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 55

**Usage** drawn on a creature or object

</column>

---

This rune is often placed on a stone in a hearth, its power ensuring the stone remains warm through the night. The bearer’s fire [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318), if any, is reduced by 5. Its [immunities](/Rules.aspx?ID=2313) are unaffected.

**Invocation**
The bearer takes 1d8 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save. On a critical failure, it's also [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round.

---
**Level (+2)** The reduction in fire resistance increases by 1, and the damage of the invocation increases by 1d8.

<traits>
<trait label="Diacritic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=948" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />

---

This diacritic surrounds the base rune with similar-looking smaller runes to give the impression of distant echoes. When the base rune is invoked, you can [Invoke a single Rune](/Actions.aspx?ID=4265) on a different rune-bearer within 15 feet of the original rune-bearer as a free action.

---
You can have only one copy of _av-, diacritic rune of succession_ applied at a given time, and once you invoke it, you can't etch or trace it again for 10 minutes.

<traits>
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 55

**Usage** drawn on a willing creature

</column>

---

This scratched rune reminds the bearer to stand strong against fear when near allies. As long as the rune-bearer is within 10 feet of one of its allies, whenever it would reduce its [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition by 1, it instead reduces it by 2.

**Invocation**
The essence of the rune is released outward, easing the minds of others. Each ally of the rune-bearer within a 10-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) reduces their frightened condition by 2.

This rune of looping swirls is difficult to look straight at and stirs up a psychic cacophony in a foe's mind. The first time each round the rune-bearer takes an action with the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait, the turmoil increases, dealing it 2 mental damage.

**Invocation**
The cacophony fragments and expands rapidly in a mental explosion, dealing 1d4 mental damage to the rune- bearer with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Will save. On a failure, the rune-bearer is [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94)  for 1 round (or stupefied 2 on a critical failure).

---
**Level (+2)** The damage from the mental turmoil increases by 1 and the damage of the invocation increases by 1d4.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 9" pfs="Standard">[Cruonign, Rune of Leeching](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=26)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Death" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=571" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
<trait label="Void" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=510" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 59

**Usage** drawn on a slashing or piercing weapon

</column>

---

The jagged shape of this rune resembles a vampire's fangs. [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with the rune-bearing weapon deal an additional 3 void damage. Whenever a living creature is damaged by one of these Strikes, the rune-bearer gains [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) equal to the void damage the target took (after applying [resistances](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) and the like). These temporary Hit Points last 1 round.

**Invocation**
The rune lashes out in a 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386) from the wielder of the weapon, dealing 4d10 void damage to each creature in the area, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save. If any creatures take damage, the wielder regains 12 Hit Points.

---
**Level (+2)** The additional void damage increases by 1, the damage of the invocation increases by 1d10, and the healing increases by 3.

---

When drawn, this knobby rune pulses with your own heartbeat, creating a vital connection between you and the bearer. While you are within 1 mile of the rune-bearer, it takes half damage from all effects that deal Hit Point damage, and you take the remainder of the damage. When you take this damage, you don't apply any [resistances](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318), [weaknesses](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317), or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage. If either you or the rune-bearer is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the rune fades without being invoked.

**Invocation**
([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623)) The connection between you and the rune-bearer is severed in a burst of healing energy. Both you and the rune-bearer regain 20 Hit Points.

---
**Level (+2)** The amount of Hit Points healed by the invocation increases by 5.

<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=662" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 55

**Usage** drawn on a creature

---

No matter what skin, shell, or scale this rune is drawn on, it shines like gold. The rune-bearer gains a +1 status bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39), and [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks.

**Invocation**
The rune draws creatures closer to the bearer. Each creature within 30 feet of the rune-bearer can [Step](/Actions.aspx?ID=2304) closer to the rune-bearer as a free action.

---
**Level (9th)** The bonus increases to +2.

**Level (17th)** The bonus increases to +3.

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=555" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 55

**Usage** drawn on a creature or object

---

This rune is often placed on chests and boxes to keep their contents from spoiling, even in the hottest of climates. The rune-bearer takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds and becomes so cold that movement becomes dangerous; if the bearer takes a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action, it becomes [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) until the beginning of its next turn.

**Invocation**
The rune-bearer takes 1d4 cold damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save. All squares on the ground in the bearer's space and adjacent squares are covered in snow, becoming [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for 1 round.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage of the invocation increases by 1d4.

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 56

**Usage** drawn on a weapon or unarmed attack that deals bludgeoning damage

</column>

---

This rune magnifies force many times over as it passes through the rune's concentric rings. The weapon or unarmed attack deals 1 bludgeoning [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage per weapon damage die. If the rune is on a melee weapon or melee unarmed attack, you and the rune-bearer are immune to this splash damage.

**Invocation**
The rune vibrates as power concentrates within it. The next successful [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) made with the weapon or unarmed attack before the end of its wielder's next turn deals an additional die of damage, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2364) 10 feet away from the attacker (20 feet on a critical failure).

<traits>
<trait label="Diacritic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=948" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 60

**Usage** drawn on a rune

</column>

---

The wavy lines of this diacritic seem to stretch the base rune into a wider area. When you draw this rune, choose a trigger that when met will invoke the base rune, using the same restrictions as for the trigger of a [Ready](/Actions.aspx?ID=2299) action. When the trigger is met, you can [Invoke the base Rune](/Actions.aspx?ID=4265) as a reaction; you can't invoke any additional runes with that reaction. If you define complicated conditions, as determined by the GM, the trigger might fail.

---
You can have only one _nesh-, diacritic rune of contingency_ applied at a given time, and once you invoke it, you can't etch or trace it again for 10 minutes.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 17" pfs="Standard">[Ochygholl, The Poisoned Star](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=42)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 61

**Usage** drawn on a creature

</column>

---

This awe-inspiring rune of pointed curves is rumored to have been part of the magic that [alghollthus](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=358) used to call down the meteoroids of the Earthfall cataclysm. The rune-bearer senses a foreboding shadow overhead and that something terrible is about to happen. This dread is contagious. The rune-bearer becomes [doomed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67), and its allies that begin their turn adjacent to the rune-bearer also become doomed 1 for 1 round. Each creature doomed this way takes 10 mental damage the first time each round it attempts an attack roll or skill check.

**Invocation**
([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) The rune calls a meteorite down on the rune-bearer, fulfilling its terrible promise. Each creature in a 10-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385) centered on a corner in the rune-bearer's space takes 3d10 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. Then, each creature within a 40-foot burst centered on that same corner takes 8d6 fire damage, also with a basic Reflex save. This invocation has the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) trait for doomed creatures.

<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 56

**Usage** drawn on a shield

</column>

---

This rune resembles a broken arrow. The shield bearing the rune gains a +2 status bonus to its [Hardness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2160) against physical damage from ranged attacks.

**Invocation**
([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) The rune creates an illusion in the minds of all creatures adjacent to the rune-bearer that lasts for 1 round. The illusion is of a large, impassable wall blocking all paths away from the rune-bearer. Creatures affected by this invocation can't willingly move farther away from the rune-bearer for 1 round or until they disbelieve the illusion, usually by using a [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) action.

---
**Level (+4)** The status bonus to Hardness increases by 1.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 9" pfs="Standard">[Oraloq, Rune of Inarticulateness](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=32)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 59

**Usage** drawn on a creature

</column>

---

This hard-to-read rune makes language difficult for the unfortunate rune-bearer. When the rune-bearer attempts a skill check or ability with the [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642) trait or attempts to [Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) that doesn't have the [subtle](/Traits.aspx?ID=522) trait, they must succeed a DC 5 [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=2278), or the action is lost.

**Invocation**
The rune-bearer must attempt a Will save as the rune puts a strong mental block on the part of their mind that interprets language. If the rune-bearer fails their save, they take 20 mental damage (or double damage on a critical failure) the first time they use any language, take a linguistic action, or Cast a Spell without the [subtle](/Traits.aspx?ID=522) trait. The rune-bearer is aware of this and knows what will trigger the damage. The effect ends once the damage is taken or at the end of the rune-bearer's next turn, whichever comes first.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage of the invocation increases by 5.

The slanted lines and odd curls of this rune give the impression that it is trying to escape. The rune-bearer can use a single action to swap places with any other willing rune-bearer within 15 feet. (The other rune-bearer can be bearing any rune.) Each creature must have room to appear in its new location or the effect is disrupted. This action has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) and [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710) traits.

**Invocation**
([teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710)) The rune grows to an enormous size, swallowing up the rune-bearer and each Large or smaller creature adjacent to them, and then immediately spits them back out. Choose a square within a 15-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) from the rune-bearer's original position for each swallowed creature to reappear. A Large creature doesn't necessarily need to reappear completely within the emanation, as long as one of its squares is. An unwilling creature avoids being teleported if it succeeds at a Will save against your class DC.

---

Upon close inspection, this rune comprises hundreds of smaller characters of various runic languages. When you etch or trace this rune, choose one language you know. The rune-bearer can speak and understand the chosen language and gains a +1 status bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47) checks and to [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) checks related to writing (such as Library Lore and Scribing Lore).

**Invocation**
The rune-bearer's voice rings clear and true, allowing them to automatically succeed at any [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=2278) that could disrupt an [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) action (such as the one imposed by the [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=66) condition) for 1 round. During this time, the bearer can also speak their true mind even if they are currently [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=64), or otherwise unable to speak.

---
**Level (9th)** The bonus increases to +2.

**Level (17th)** The bonus increases to +3.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 9" pfs="Standard">[Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=34)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=534" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 60

**Usage** drawn onto a creature

</column>

---

This rune calls to mind the beauty hidden in sorrow. While this rune is beautiful, sorrow is best admired from a distance, discouraging approach. Enemies within 20 feet of the rune-bearer treat all spaces between them and the rune-bearer as [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366).

**Invocation**
Sorrow blots out the capacity for any other action. Each enemy in a 15-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) around the rune-bearer must succeed at a Will saving throw or be [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for 1 round as it spends the first action of its next turn sobbing (slowed 2 on a critical failure). Regardless of the outcome, the creature is then temporarily immune to the invocation of _trolistri, rune of forlorn sorrow_ for 1 hour.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 9" pfs="Standard">[Ulgatus, Rune of Restraint](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=35)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 60

**Usage** drawn on armor

</column>

---

A faction of the constructed beings called automatons developed this rune to avoid the weaknesses of flesh. When the creature wearing the armor would gain or increase the value of their [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) condition, the rune attempts to prevent the imposition. The bearer attempts a DC 15 [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=2278). On a success, it doesn't gain or increase the value of that condition, but the rune goes temporarily dormant for 10 minutes. While dormant, the rune can't protect the bearer from conditions but can be invoked.

**Invocation**
The rune causes the armor to grow around the creature wearing it, fortifying any vulnerable spots. For 1 minute, the wearer gains [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to critical hits.

---
**Level (17th)** The DC of the flat check decreases to 10 and the resistance to critical hits increases to 20.

<title level="1" right="Runesmith Rune 17" pfs="Standard">[Xinsala, The Well of Virtues](/RunesmithRunes.aspx?ID=44)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Rune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=951" />
<trait label="Runesmith" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=952" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 61

**Usage** drawn on an unoccupied square

</column>

---

This complex rune comprises many different ligatures from the ancient Thassilonian runes representing the seven virtues of rule, before they were corrupted by the runelords. When drawn, it creates a well of glowing energy that occupies the square it's drawn on and creates an aura of swirling, virtuous runes in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387). While in the aura, you or any of your allies gain a +1 status bonus to AC against magic, a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to damage from magical effects.

**Invocation**
([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) The well explodes outward with invigorating force. The well heals any number of creatures in its area for a total of 70 Hit Points divided as you choose, and you and each of your allies in the area gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speeds and are [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=89) for 1 round. The extra action from quickened can be used only to [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) or [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306).

<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />

---

This majestic rune grants the shield's wielder the conviction to aid their allies. While a shield bearing this rune is raised, its bearer emits an aura in a 10-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) that grants their allies a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

**Invocation**
The shield regains 40 Hit Points, and all of the bearer's allies in a 10-foot emanation gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks for 1 round.

---
**Level (+3)** The Hit Points restored increases by 10.

---

This circular mark allows travelers to always find their way home. The rune-bearer gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds, but only when its movement would end closer to you than where the creature started its turn.

**Invocation**
([teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710)) You call the rune-bearer to your side. You teleport the target to any unoccupied square adjacent to you. If the bearer is unwilling, it must succeed at a Will save to negate the effect.
